companyDescription: Rockets, spacecraft & lunar landers · first commercial firm to complete a successful Moon landing (Blue Ghost) · real NASA contract wins landing even as the stock declines on them — a genuine sentiment/fundamentals divergence
priceNote: Self-fetched today (no live-prices.json cache yet). Down 2.18% today and down sharply from the 52-week high ($73.80) despite a string of fresh NASA contract wins this month — one of the clearer fundamentals-vs-sentiment divergences on the board right now.
summary: This report updates an honest read: Firefly's real upside has compressed since the last board refresh. The 9-analyst consensus of $48.11 (+133% from here) is real and broad, and Roth Capital's $60 target (+191%) is the highest named figure — both fall short of the classic 200%+ turbo floor on a strict basis, though Roth's target comes close. What hasn't changed is the underlying story: Firefly keeps landing real NASA contracts ($144M Blue Ghost lunar mission, $13M JPL SkyFall subcontract in July alone) even as the stock declines and short interest rises (13.19M shares, up from 11.84M) — a genuine disconnect between fundamentals and price. Balance sheet is strong ($392M cash, 3+ years of runway, low debt), removing near-term survival risk. Q2 2026 earnings Aug 11 is the next real catalyst to test whether the contract wins start changing sentiment.

catalysts.name: NASA Contract Momentum
catalysts.description: $144M NASA contract for a Blue Ghost lunar mission (2028) plus a $13M JPL SkyFall Mars-mission subcontract landed within weeks of each other in July — real, ongoing revenue-visibility wins even though the stock hasn't rewarded them yet.

risks: Real upside has compressed below this board's typical 200%+ bar — 9-analyst consensus is +133%, and even the highest named target (Roth Capital $60) is +191%, not quite 200%. This is now a borderline, not a clean turbo pick

The stock has fallen despite a string of fresh NASA contract wins in July — a genuine, persistent sentiment/fundamentals divergence that hasn't resolved itself yet, and there's no guarantee it resolves before Aug 11
Short interest rose to 13.19M shares from 11.84M — real, funded bear conviction, not just weak sentiment
Both major NASA contracts ($144M Blue Ghost, $13M SkyFall) target 2028 missions — the cash doesn't flow immediately, and the market may be discounting the multi-year lag
Free cash flow of -$78.9M in Q1 shows real ongoing cash burn even with a strong balance sheet — the 3+ year runway is a buffer, not a sign the business is near self-funding

macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — Firefly's own contract wins are macro-independent, but the sector-wide sentiment weakness already pulling this stock down (partly SpaceX-IPO-driven capital rotation) means a hawkish Jul 28-29 FOMC surprise would add another headwind on top.
